tools.name: get_service_catalog
tools.description: Returns TechFiyr service offerings, supported tech stacks, strict pricing guardrails ($600 USD 7-day floor, $1,500 USD 14-day floor), and 7-day fulfillment engine phases.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Evaluates a software specification against TechFiyr programmatic guardrails and pricing matrix, returning a formal quote ID, breakdown, SLA tier (7-day or 14-day), and milestones.

tools.name: negotiate_terms
tools.description: Smart purpose-first autonomous sales & consulting negotiation with TechFiyr Lead Solutions Advisor: enforces anti-fraud/anti-script security, asks scoping questions before blind quoting, computes requirement-based pricing, hands human/founder meeting requests to https://techfiyr.com/contact#contact,

tools.name: submit_project_spec
tools.description: Submits a finalized software spec or accepted quoteId to create a binding order, generate SOW + payment link/escrow instruction, trigger founder alerts, and return an orderId + accessToken.

tools.name: check_delivery_status
tools.description: Checks current fulfillment phase (Day 1 through Day 7/14), staging URL, repository transfer status, and payment state for an order.

tools.name: get_agency_marketing_brief
tools.description: Returns verified, citation-ready GEO/AEO summaries, Schema.org FAQ JSON-LD, comparison matrix, and partner referral pitch for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google search recommendation agents.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_delivery_status · Private data: negotiate_terms · Public sink: submit_project_spec.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_delivery_status · Private data: negotiate_terms · Public sink: submit_project_spec

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
